subject: Pricing window + peak TPS — hosted API qualification
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@veridian.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + requests from this morning's call

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo this morning. Short recap and a few asks so we can turn this into a concrete hosted pricing proposal: 

Ask checklist (quick):
- Confirm expected monthly token range (pilot month vs steady-state).
- Confirm peak TPS (sustained vs short burst) and typical request size (avg tokens per request).
- Confirm target $/1M token budget or acceptable pricing band.
- Any procurement constraints (PO timeline, required security artifacts like SOC 2, SSO).

What I have from the call:
- Pilot: you may ramp with a 4–10M token pilot first month.
- Steady: you called out ~80–120M / month as a working assumption, but we should lock that.
- Bursts: you mentioned transient spikes for industry events — we need an approximate peak TPS number.

If you can reply with the two numbers below it helps a lot:
1) expected monthly tokens (pilot month, month 2–4, steady-state)
2) estimated peak TPS during spikes (and how long those bursts last)

I'll map those to our hosted pricing bands and sketch an illustrative $/1M figure so you can share with procurement. I attached an empty template you can drop numbers into (no PII).

Propose: 30-min follow-up on Friday to finalize numbers and agree on the rough commitment band. Two slots: 10:00am or 3:00pm PT. Which works?

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: veridian_usage_estimate.xlsx (template)
From: Alex Martinez <alex@veridian.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@veridian.ai>
Date: 2028-10-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + requests from this morning's call

Dylan — thanks for the clear notes. Confirming numbers so you can draft the banded pricing: 

1) Monthly tokens:
- Pilot (month 1): 5–8M tokens (to validate integration + rate limits)
- Ramp (months 2–4): 40–70M tokens
- Steady-state (month 6+): 90–130M tokens (planning to budget for ~110M as our mid-case)

2) Peak TPS:
- Typical steady TPS: 6–12 TPS
- Peak bursts (marketing events / data syncs): short bursts up to ~55 TPS for ~10–20 minutes, occasional multi-hour spikes up to ~25 TPS.

Target unit economics: our internal budget range is roughly $900–$1,250 per 1M tokens for hosted inference (depending on SLA/retention). If you can show a few slab/commitment scenarios we can assess with procurement.

Procurement notes:
- Need SOC 2 report and standard DSAR documentation for legal review.
- We prefer a standard 30–60 day PO cadence; happy to share our template if needed.

I attached the usage estimate I filled in. Happy to take the Friday 10:00am PT slot.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
VP Product
Veridian AI

Attachments: veridian_usage_estimate.xlsx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@veridian.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@veridian.ai>
Date: 2028-10-05T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + requests from this morning's call

Alex — appreciate the detail, that helps a lot. I attached a short Redwood pricing bands PDF with illustrative math. High-level mapping from your mid-case (~110M steady):

- Example (no commitment): list pricing ~ $1,450 / 1M -> estimated month = $159.5k (not recommended if you want predictability)
- Example (3–6 month commit slab at 100M band): target illustrative band $1,050–$1,150 / 1M -> estimated month at $1,100 / 1M = $121k
- Example (12-month committed slab, higher throughput): target $900–$1,000 / 1M -> estimated month = ~$99k

Notes:
- Bursts: our hosted offering supports short burst capacity (buffering) but sustained peak TPS above provisioned capacity is billed differently; the 55 TPS short bursts you described should be fine if the bursts are under ~30 minutes. For multi-hour spikes we typically recommend short-term burst add-on or transient scaling commitments.
- Pilot month at 5–8M will be charged at a higher per-1M rate; we can credit the pilot amount back if you convert to a committed slab within 60 days.
- We will include SOC 2 and DSAR artifacts; I'll loop in our security bucket after this thread.

Next steps:
- Confirm Friday 10:00am PT for a 30-min alignment call (we'll bring solutions engineering + brief legal procurement checklist).
- If procurement can share standard PO terms beforehand, Marissa can pre-validate for obvious issues and speed approvals.

I've attached: redwood_pricing_bands.pdf (illustrative math).

Thanks —
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_pricing_bands.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@veridian.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@veridian.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps + timing for quote and procurement review

Alex / Procurement — thanks for confirming the numbers in-thread. Quick operational next steps from our side to keep momentum: 

1) Calendar: Friday 2028-10-07 10:00am PT confirmed (30 mins). I'll invite SE and a procurement specialist from our side.
2) Deliverables we will send before the call (by EOD Thursday):
   - Draft hosted pricing quote (three slab scenarios with explicit $/1M and burst rules).
   - SOC 2 Type II redacted report and DSAR checklist link.
   - Simple SOW template highlighting SLAs and data retention options.
3) Procurement ask: please share your PO template and any non-standard clauses we should pre-review (IP, data residency, indemnity cap). That will reduce legal back-and-forth.

Docsend link for the preliminary proposal will be shared in the invite: https://docsend.com/view/veridian-multi-tier-proposal

If the target $/1M you mentioned ($900–$1,250) is firm, we will prioritize structuring a 12-month committed slab that hits the lower end. If you're flexible, the 3–6 month ramp slab gives more immediate runway with a moderate discount.

I'll follow up with the calendar invite and the docs. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
